theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners ranks #2 (score 2.015) with the strongest combination of durability (0.79), full breadth (1.0), and no crowding (z=0.69). It is the only high-ranking theme with breadth at 1.0, meaning the entire proxy (SIL) is trending rather than a few names. The trend-gate is the one validated drawdown-control leg and this theme is eligible. This is a trend-following lean, not a momentum-alpha claim.
theses.dissent: Silver miners are highly volatile and sensitive to industrial demand and the USD; a hawkish Fed surprise or China slowdown could hit SIL hard regardless of trend texture. The theme is also #2 behind a much stronger leader, and the challenger margin (1.035) could widen against it.

falsifier.text: SIL loses its absolute uptrend and falls below its own 50-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners ranks #3 (score 1.823) with the highest durability_bar on the board (0.84), full breadth (1.0), and a clean 'trend' hurst tag. No crowding (z=0.55). This is the most durable trending theme in the ranks — a defensive, trend-following lean consistent with the validated absolute-trend gate.
theses.dissent: Gold miners have already had a strong run and real yields moving higher would pressure them. The theme is #3 behind Silver Miners and the leader, so it may just be part of a broader precious-metals complex rather than a distinct leadership.

falsifier.text: GDX breaks below its own 50-day moving average while the S&P 500 remains above its trend gate

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks #6 (score 0.665) with a 'trend' tag and high durability_bar (0.78) BUT is the most crowded theme on the board (crowding_z 1.57, crowded=true). Crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade — but combined with a middling rank and directional accuracy of only 0.378 in the track record, this is a theme to stay out of rather than press.
theses.dissent: Crowding flags have no validated forward edge for diversified baskets and do NOT predict drawdown. The theme could keep trending higher on persistent security-spending narratives; avoiding it could mean missing gains.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding_z falls below 1.0 AND its momentum score rises into the top 3 before the check-by date
